route_length gives up on our delivery network: asking for the route from the
depot to the mill raises RouteError ("no route from 'depot' to 'mill'"), yet
the mill is connected and every road can be driven both ways. The network:

    depot-farm:1
    depot-bridge:4
    farm-bridge:1
    mill-bridge:1

The shortest route from the depot to the mill is depot, farm, bridge, mill:
3 km.
